correctness.rationale: On σ1=0 in characteristic3, symmetric σ4 is invariant under common translation x→x+c(1,…,1), proving that B is cone over Q=x0=0. Critical derivative equations x_i³+p2 x_i equal imply either all coordinates equal (vertex) or four equal and a pair differ oppositely, yielding precisely 15 lines and rational base nodes. At base representative (0,0,0,0,1,−1), the quadratic term −(uv+uw+vw) has nonzero Hessian determinant 1 mod3, giving A1 nodes. Isolated singularities imply Q integral normal; resolution of quartic rational double points gives K3. Exhaustive projective F3 and F9 counts Q=25,145 and B=76,1306 verified independently. Replacing each split rational node adds q points, so Y(F3)=70,Y(F9)=280. K3 b2=22 and |α|=3 make the F9 maximal count force α²=9 by triangle equality, and F3 trace gives 21 plus/one minus; point counts and zeta follow. Claim expressly excludes alternate nonflat five-coordinate char3 reduction.
